Messages.Author: ar...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
When I can get my hands on sufficient numbers through trading,
I'm aching to try a Malkavian/Nosfer-Anti Madness Network/
Using the Advantage Deck. Make it hybrid of !Nosferatish ani/POT
rush and Malkavian bleed, maybe with Night Moves for inherent
stealth. Can the Malkavian in the end-of-turn Madness action use
Action cards like Night Moves?

Anyway, the idea is to make sure that you get the Edge right before
your turn, and then use massive numbers of Using the Advantage
to gain 6-10 pool a round. Maybe even use the Malkavian Victoria
for added *SAUCE*.

My tally right now is at
Madness Networks - 0
Using the Advantage - 1

Clearly I have some trading to do. . .

Scott Harris

Actually, David Zopf (hi Dave, stand up and take your prize) was able to
put this deck together a while ago. It works very very nicely if he can
get out the Using the Advantage (he probably had about five). Also, the
Victoria angle helps the deck too. It was a beast to try and bleed him,
and he was consistently plinking his prey with Night Moves.
We started referring to the his untap phase as the "gain seven pool
phase"
